name: Build Shift Count Query

func: const rows=(Array.isArray(msg.payload)?msg.payload:[]).filter(r=>r._time&&Number.isFinite(Number(r._value))).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a._time)-new Date(b._time)); const points=rows.map(r=>({time:new Date(r._time).toISOString(),value:Number(r._value),tileSize:String(r.tileSize||"")})); msg.headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Cache-Control":"no-store"}; msg.payload={success:true,...msg.seriesMeta,points,cursor:points.length?points[points.length-1].time:null};return msg;
